$comment: The shared layer over the other repos, scoped to this one: audience `investor`. The tool set and the corpus projection are fixed by that audience and cannot be widened from a call — see portfolio-commons/src/portfolio_commons/audiences.py. Read-only by design: writes go through the owning repo's CLI or a branch and a PR. Absolute path because a GUI-launched client does not inherit the shell PATH; if this repo moves, re-run `uv tool install --editable ~/Desktop/Code/portfolio-commons`.
